what_this_measures: the cost of building the index fixture's corpus on this host, split by phase, and again with the platform's sync calls disabled. It is a test-fixture measurement for defect 114, not a product benchmark.

extrapolated_to_the_fixture.note: linear extrapolation of this host's per-capsule cost; the fixture also moves each capsule into one directory, which is not linear on every filesystem, so this is an order-of-magnitude figure

what_a_windows_runner_would_have_to_pay: the same phases, with `FlushFileBuffers` per sync and a Defender scan per close. The sync share above is the part of this fixture whose cost differs most between ext4 and NTFS; the tape and seal phases are the same work everywhere.
